title: Find a bean by name
summary: Spring Framework: Find a bean by name. Rename the method and the lookup together.
introduction: The method name becomes the bean name. This example asks for the bean called school.
learningObjectives: Find a bean by name with Spring Framework
Rename the method and the lookup together

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Find a bean by name

blocks.text: The factory method name school becomes the bean name. The lookup asks for that name and String type.
Rename the method and the lookup together.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The requested name must match a registered bean.
